name: vitest-native
description: Run real React Native tests under Vitest. One install, zero config.
author: Daniel Fry

scripts.test:native: node scripts/run-scripts.mjs test:native:no-globals test:native:main test:native:per-file test:native:rntl-timers test:native:one-instance test:native:context test:native:shared-root test:native:preset-modules test:native:permissive test:native:reanimated-fallback test:native:partial-mock-external test:native:tsconfig-paths test:native:regex-alias test:native:dispatch-alias test:native:jest-registry-node-mocks test:native:jest-compat-restore-mocks test:native:node-mocks test:native:ownership test:native:project-js-jsx test:native:jest-globals-require test:native:compile-error test:native:project-babel test:native:rn-deep-mock test:native:root-mocks test:native:library-setup-preset-off

scripts.lint: oxlint --deny-warnings src/ tests/ tests-native/ crosscheck/ consumer-tests/ scripts/ lint/

scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check src/ tests/ consumer-tests/ scripts/ lint/
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run build && bun run check:size && bun run test && bun run test:native && bun run test:native:forks && bun run test:native:navigation && bun run test:native:android && bun run test:native:advice && bun run test:native:hot && bun run test:native:hot:isolation && bun run test:native:hot:state-manifest && bun run test:native:hot:soak && bun run validate:hot-parity && bun run validate:registry-process && bun run fidelity:check && bun run test:consumers && bun run lint && bun run typecheck
